about: jevzip datasets: keys under 'files' are paths relative to data/, under 'downloads' relative to downloads/. Built by `python -m jevzip.data {code,enwik8,text8,silesia,ood}`, checked by `python -m jevzip.data verify`. 'reproducible': false marks files built from this machine's installed packages (the code corpus). Suites name the files each benchmark runs on; ood/binary and ood/non-english reference Silesia files rather than copying them.

code/train.bin.source: built on this machine by `python -m jevzip.data code` from CPython 3.12.13's stdlib and the .venv's site-packages (os.walk order, files joined by '\n\n'); depends on the installed packages, so NOT rebuildable bit-identically elsewhere
code/train.bin.license: the licenses of the individual packages (mostly BSD/MIT/Apache/PSF); see each package's metadata
code/train.bin.split: train: every package except mpmath, networkx, pydoc_data

code/val.bin.source: built on this machine by `python -m jevzip.data code` from CPython 3.12.13's stdlib and the .venv's site-packages (os.walk order, files joined by '\n\n'); depends on the installed packages, so NOT rebuildable bit-identically elsewhere

code/networkx.py.txt.source: built on this machine by `python -m jevzip.data code` from CPython 3.12.13's stdlib and the .venv's site-packages (os.walk order, files joined by '\n\n'); depends on the installed packages, so NOT rebuildable bit-identically elsewhere; released as jevzip-code-testset.tar.xz
code/networkx.py.txt.split: test: the first 1 MiB (1048576 bytes) of the networkx package

code/pydoc_topics.txt.source: built on this machine by `python -m jevzip.data code` from CPython 3.12.13's stdlib and the .venv's site-packages (os.walk order, files joined by '\n\n'); depends on the installed packages, so NOT rebuildable bit-identically elsewhere; released as jevzip-code-testset.tar.xz

code/networkx-files/index.json.source: python -m jevzip.data code: the networkx files as they appear in networkx.py.txt (offset, size, full size, SHA-256); the files sit next to it
code/networkx-files/index.json.split: test (per-file view of networkx.py.txt; the last file is cut at 1 MiB)
